said: The Riksbank's real responses, recorded by meridian-riksbank's authors on 2026-11-19 from its public API without a key, each series' answer as received, keyed by the Riksbank's series id and gzipped: SWESTR, its 1-week and 1, 2, 3 and 6-month averages and its index (the SWESTR API), the policy rate (SECBREPOEFF), the 2, 5, 7 and 10-year government bond yields (SEGVB2YC to SEGVB10YC, sourced from Refinitiv) and 29 exchange rates against the krona (SEK<code>PMI), each from 3 August to 19 November 2026, and the exchange rates' latest (group 130). Source: Sveriges Riksbank; SWESTR is administered by Sveriges Riksbank; its data may be used with the Riksbank cited as source (https://www.riksbank.se/en-gb/statistics/swestr/conditions-for-use-and-re-publishing/). Sample data answers each request from them, and the tests read them.
